protocol.world_clock_owner: One MATTERIX/IsaacLab environment; reset only between positive and omit-second episodes, no reset between additions

native_configuration.scale_rule: 22 native particles *1e-6kg / original48g dose; multiply all Methods solvent/solute quantities by the same factor
native_configuration.solver: One original public FluidSystem / one PhysxParticleSystem; stable particle-index labels identify source stocks. Different PhysX particle systems do not collide, per official docs, so no independent-system mixing claim.
native_configuration.physics_and_render: Original FluidCfg physical defaults, anisotropy/smoothing/isosurface retained; spatial color function feeds original ClearWater color inputs as an explicitly uncalibrated semantic proxy.
native_configuration.cup_configuration: Public scale1 cup, conservative67mL mesh cavity; native parameter mass is not calibrated rendered volume or density.
native_configuration.mass_quantization: 46 native receiver particles represent the uniformly scaled initial Methods solvent+KI mass within0.3%; do not claim exact continuous-mass initialization. Report the residual in the final native mass ledger.
native_configuration.native_preflight: Subsytem only:22 labeled incoming particles initialized above46 receiver particles fall under gravity;22 reference particles stay in another cup. Shared solver interaction, finite states, retention and spatial tint are checked before any robot-mediated two-addition claim.
native_configuration.preflight_not_experiment: No native N08 redox trial, no robot-mediated dose, no F_PASS may be inferred from this fixture.
native_configuration.two_addition_native_next: Reuse the frozen N04 physical side-grasp/mouth-pivot controller for both source cups, same world/time across both additions; actual ingress drives native_adapter; first completed addition starts50s native reaction wait; reject any confirmed receiver outflow.

kinetics.source: Carraher, Curry, Tessonnier, J Chem Educ 2016, DOI 10.1021/acs.jchemed.5b00640, Results and Discussion, measured uncatalyzed k2
kinetics.temperature_scope: Source classroom experiment, precise temperature not stated in the accessible main article; local nominal25C is an assumption. No Arrhenius correction or original MATTERIX kinetics claim.
kinetics.acid_catalysis: Not modeled; no added strong acid. Source also measures acid branch0.170 M^-2 s^-1, not used as a free tuning parameter.
kinetics.reduction: Fast irreversible stoichiometric limit: extent=min(n_I2,n_ascorbic). No invented finite k_fast and no quantitative bleaching-time prediction.
kinetics.reduction_limit_primary: https://arxiv.org/html/2408.04108v2, sections1-2, fast vitaminC reaction and separation of timescales; quantitative fitted40C oxidation parameter from that paper is NOT used.

recipe.stock_mass_basis: Dose bulk masses follow the measured48g increase; stock water is bulk minus solute mass. Receiver is100g solvent+4mmol KI. Unknown starch mass is excluded; indicator presence is a boolean.
recipe.source: MATTERIX Nature main Methods, Reduction-Oxidation Execution Protocol; local references/matterix_arxiv_full_with_supplement_r1.txt lines1062-1100
recipe.native_scaling_rule: A single explicit scale may multiply all water, solute and dose quantities to match physical stock capacity; concentrations and kinetic constants remain unchanged. No native run is claimed by this offline fixture.

protocol.controller: Original N04 side-grasp and mouth-pivot115deg controller; per-pour90s native budget,>=50% receiver,<=10% spill,15mm grasp-translation and4mm gross wall gate. Engineering integration repair: second source(.40,.18) yaw-23.674deg, same already validated grasp orientation as first source. Subsequent skill starts explicitOpen then withdraws100mm along old actual negativeEE-Z plus50mm upward, before high-position reorientation/second approach. First source maximum disturbance after return<=5mm. No change to PBD/chemistry/quality thresholds; multiple engineering changes, no single-variable causal attribution.
protocol.event_coupling: Observed3-consecutive-control-frame deep receiver ingress*originalparticlemass drives unique chemical transfer packets, not desired command or scheduled dose. Actual native callback/time checked each observation.
protocol.first_addition_complete_definition: Full first native pour, upright return and gripper release, starts50s native wait. This conservative local operation timing is not the published flow-end protocol timing.
protocol.negative: Same first actual pour and50s wait; second source untouched and55s extra native hold approximates local second operation duration; then50s assay. Actual total duration separately reported.
protocol.outflow_rule: Reject episode if an initial/confirmed delivered receiver particle leaves the receiver conservative cavity+4mm for3 consecutive observations; no unmodeled mixed outflow.
protocol.video: Native live rendered state every30control steps (0.5s),2fps; frame map records native timestamps. Long command phases retain their true native duration.
